tasks.goal: Build a single-page web app that stores a personal recipe box in localStorage, letting users add recipes with ingredients and steps, search by ingredient, and mark favorites.
Build a small HTTP API for tracking book loans among friends, with endpoints to register books, record loans/returns, and list overdue items, backed by a local SQLite file.
Build a small desktop-style app for tracking daily habit streaks, letting users add habits, check them off each day, and view current streak counts.
